gold_answer: Athlyte Search currently supports deep statistical searching for Men's Football, Men's Basketball, Women's Basketball, Men's Ice Hockey, Women's Ice Hockey, Men's Soccer, Women's Soccer, Men's Volleyball, and Women's Volleyball. question: What sections are on the player dashboard?
gold_answer: The Player Dashboard has five sections: Player Statistics (seasonal aggregate stats, filterable by season and category), Player Records (individual game performances, rank, and the value to beat), Season & Career Highs (best single-game marks with date and opponent), Player Game Log (every game in a selected season), and Player Streaks (consecutive-game performances).

question: How do filters work on search results?
gold_answer: You can refine search results from the sidebar without retyping your query. These filters apply to all query types except Streaks and include opponent and conference, game result (wins or losses), game type (regular season or post-season), date range, player metadata (name, position, or class year), and period type (such as first half or overtime).

rag.answer: Use the filters on the results screen to narrow matches without re-running your query. Available filters include Name, Date (custom date range), Period Type, and Results (match result). Filters apply to all query types except Streaks.
